title: Flange with a six-hole bolt circle
caption: An 80 mm flange, 8 mm thick, with a 30 mm bore and six 6 mm bolt holes on a 60 mm circle. Diameter, thickness, bolt size and bolt circle are named parameters. Measured volume is 33,200 mm³, matching the hand calculation.

title: Rounded open enclosure
caption: A 60×40×25 mm box with 5 mm rounded corners, shelled to 2 mm walls with the top left open. Changing the length to 80 mm rebuilds it with all four rounds kept.
